v4.why: 8-day self-drive trip, 22–29 Dec: Kochi (Fort Kochi morning) → Munnar (2 nights) → Thekkady (1) → Alleppey houseboat on Christmas night → Varkala (2 days) → Thiruvananthapuram and Kovalam (2 nights) → Kochi. About 940 km, 29 h 25 min of driving, every drive a timed leg. ₹89,870 for the group, about ₹30,000 each.
